purpose: Preserve explicitly rejected line families and rejected draw-selection patterns so visual mistakes are not silently reintroduced.

entries.reason: H1 MID_DOW FALLING family was visually reviewed and confirmed unnecessary for the 09/19 reference. Its mapped H4 copy is also unnecessary.
entries.enforcement: NVT9_0919_REFERENCE_LINES_V01.json display_override=SUPPRESSED

entries.reason: When zone_width is zero, the dashed zone edge is identical to the solid TL/CH and visually overwrites it.
entries.enforcement: build_nvt9_0919_reference.py omits zone edges when abs(zone_width)<=1e-12

entries.reason: Visual audit showed the duration-first selector can choose a long but obsolete shallow D1 support line below the intended active broad support.
entries.enforcement: build_nvt9_structural_overlay_0919.py requires broad structural duration when available, then selects the tightest unbroken support at the cutoff.

entries.reason: Parallel reaction zones must not overlap; when overlap occurs, the weaker-scoring zone is rejected rather than merged into a wider ambiguous band.
entries.enforcement: cluster_reaction_zones keeps only the strongest non-overlapping zones.

entries.reason: Restricting D1 continuation anchor2 to only the latest four lows can exclude an older major pullback low that still owns the broad support structure.
entries.enforcement: build_d1_continuation no longer applies the last-four-low anchor2 gate and validates closed-bar support for the whole candidate life.

entries.reason: A mapped M15 line may be displayed on H1, but it must not substitute for the H1-native TL/HL structure or own H1 reaction zones and Updated CH.
entries.enforcement: H1 overlay now builds X0919-H1-CONT-01 from H1 bars/pivots; zones and Updated CH use that family only.

entries.reason: Four non-overlapping bands can still be visually too dense. H1 zones must be structurally separated, not merely mathematically non-overlapping.
entries.enforcement: H1 zones are capped at three; centers must be at least 1.25 median H1 bar ranges apart; each zone needs at least four reacting bars and body-weight >= 6.0.

entries.reason: At the 2026-09-12 cutoff, the 600-closed-bar replay produces zero selected CURRENT H4 families. Do not invent or borrow a replacement H4 source line solely to satisfy a one-family preview assumption.
entries.enforcement: build_nvt9_reference_0912.py opts H4 into --allow-empty-source-tf; build_nvt9_tf_mapped_preview.py records H4 as an empty source selection and skips its source-copy/HL rows.
entries.superseded_reason: CURRENT=0 does not mean structural history disappears. For 09/12, the last retained H4 PREVIOUS family must remain visible and map to D1.

entries.reason: 09/12 visual audit identified the selected H1 FALLING source family and its mapped H4 copy as unnecessary compared with the frozen 09/19 structure.
entries.enforcement: build_nvt9_reference_0912.py passes --suppress-selected-source-direction H1:FALLING; preview removes the source, its mapped copies, and its source Decision-HL.

entries.reason: 09/12 visual audit showed the selected D1 rising base family as a shallow/duplicate structure while the broad multi-month rising TL/CH was missing.
entries.enforcement: 09/12 base preview suppresses D1:RISING and structural overlay emits X0912-D1-MAJOR-01 TL/CH/HL when the major channel passes.
entries.superseded_reason: The user later marked the exact D1 LOW/LOW pair. Generic major-channel selection is no longer authoritative for this 09/12 target.

entries.reason: A two-anchor H1 TL does not exist as an actionable line before anchor2 forms. Requiring the projected line to remain untouched from anchor1 can suppress the H1-native TL and its Decision HL even when the formed structure is valid after anchor2.
entries.enforcement: build_h1_native_continuation prefers full-life strict candidates, otherwise accepts an H1-native higher-low N structure only if no closed H1 bar breaks the line after anchor2; Decision HL remains tied to that same family.

entries.reason: The prior 09/12 major-channel attempt incorrectly required anchor1 age <=480 days and a near-current-price support gap. Those generic filters can exclude the retained 2025 D1 reference identified by GT_0004/NVT5 evidence.
entries.enforcement: 09/12 first calls build_d1_retained_reference_0912 using the NVT5 GT_0004 anchor windows; generic major selection is fallback only.
entries.superseded_reason: GT_0004 2025 retained-reference windows describe a different D1 reference and were incorrectly applied to the yellow-circle 09/12 target.

entries.reason: The retained D1 reference must preserve its original formed channel geometry. A later 2026 high must not silently expand/re-anchor the historical 2025 CH.
entries.enforcement: For the retained 09/12 D1 reference, CH candidates are limited to anchor1 through 30 days after anchor2 and prefer post-anchor2 formation contacts.

entries.reason: The 09/12 historical viewer previously rendered audit TL/CH/HL with RAY_RIGHT, making valid pre-cutoff lines look like new post-09/12 geometry. This must not be interpreted as a separate valid future line.
entries.enforcement: NCA_NVT9_AB_View projects base-preview geometry to the 09/12 cutoff and renders it with RAY_RIGHT=false; 09/12 structural overlay is also non-ray.
entries.superseded_reason: The no-lookahead cutoff constrains data used to select anchors, not the rightward display projection of an already-established TL/CH.

entries.reason: The previous correction incorrectly treated the GT_0004 2025 retained D1 reference as the line identified by the user's two yellow circles. The annotated target is a different 2026 LOW->LOW line.
entries.enforcement: NVT9_0912_VISUAL_TRUTH_V01.json defines approved 2026 anchor windows and runtime verification fails if generated D1 anchors fall outside them.

entries.reason: Stale live/manual chart objects survived the historical replay and appeared as post-cutoff TLs even after audit geometry was corrected.
entries.enforcement: NCA_NVT9_AB_View forces clean isolation for CASE_20260912/VARIANT_OLD before drawing the base and structural overlay.
entries.superseded_reason: Deleting every chart object was stronger than necessary. Historical replay now removes NCA/NVT9 generated objects while preserving unrelated/manual objects.

entries.reason: Selecting the two D1 anchors independently can produce an inner rising TL that cuts through another formation wick. The user's aqua reference is the outer support envelope.
entries.enforcement: build_d1_visual_truth_0912 evaluates LOW/LOW pairs jointly and rejects any pair with a D1 wick below the TL between anchor1 and anchor2; runtime verifier requires zero formation wick breaches.

entries.reason: At the 09/12 cutoff, H4 can have no CURRENT family while an older valid monitoring structure still exists. That retained family must not disappear solely because CURRENT is empty.
entries.enforcement: 09/12 first uses CURRENT. If absent, PREVIOUS may be retained. If both are absent, the frozen 09/19 H4 anchor pair is accepted only when the exact pair rebuilds as a valid ChannelCandidate from 09/12 pre-cutoff bars; Decision HL and CH are recomputed from those bars.

entries.reason: Future bars must not participate in selecting the 09/12 structure, but the TL/CH that already existed at 09/12 remains a monitoring reference projected to the right.
entries.enforcement: 09/12 package is built from pre-cutoff bars only; NCA_NVT9_AB_View renders selected base references and approved D1 references with RAY_RIGHT.

entries.reason: A clean historical replay must remove stale NCA/NVT9 generated geometry without treating unrelated/manual chart objects as structural history.
entries.enforcement: For 09/12 OLD, the viewer removes NCA_/NCA_DRAW__/NVT9-generated objects, preserves unrelated manual objects, then redraws base and overlay geometry.

entries.reason: The 09/12 600-bar lifecycle state can contain no H4 CURRENT/PREVIOUS even though the earlier frozen visual reference used an H4 structure whose anchors predate 09/12.
entries.enforcement: R0919 H4 anchor identity is used only as a lookup target. detect_turns/build_channel_candidates rerun on the 09/12 pre-cutoff input; the exact anchor pair must exist there as a valid candidate. CH offset, Decision HL, activation, and zone evidence come from the pre-cutoff candidate, not from 09/19 future geometry.

entries.reason: At the 09/05 cutoff the rebuilt state can contain no H1 CURRENT family. The first visual audit must try retained evidence before deciding the chart has no H1 line.
entries.enforcement: 09/05 H1 selection now tries CURRENT, then PREVIOUS, then revalidates frozen H1 reference anchors using only pre-cutoff H1 bars. If all routes are absent, H1 NO-LINE is allowed for the first visual audit.

entries.reason: User audit decision: M15 movement is too abrupt/noisy for stable native TL/CH selection. M15 should show the same structural family as H1 rather than create a separate M15 geometry.
entries.enforcement: NVT9_TF_DISPLAY_MAP_H1_TO_M15_V02 removes M15 from source_to_display_tfs, marks M15 native-disabled, and maps the H1-selected family to H1/H4/M15. build_nvt9_tf_mapped_preview.py rejects any native-disabled source leak.

entries.reason: A valid structural gap exists after the prior TL is broken but before two replacement anchors plus the Decision-HL break establish the next TL. Treating this gap as generic NO-LINE loses the parent-TF monitoring structure.
entries.enforcement: tools/live_draw/tl_transition.py resolves ACTIVE/TRANSITION_NO_TL/NEW_ACTIVE after selector output. NVT9_TF_DISPLAY_MAP_TRANSITION_V03 uses the state before mapping: H4 TRANSITION inherits D1; M15 native-disabled inherits H1. NEW_ACTIVE is permitted only from the existing activated N rules.
